Kames Capital Plc decreased its stake in Facebook Inc. (FB) by 4.69% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Kames Capital Plc sold 45,105 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.10% with the market. The institutional investor held 916,961 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $161.86 million, down from 962,066 at the end of the previous reported quarter.
